name: TOB Bible Place
description: One biblical place (e.g. Jerusalem, Mount Sinai). Admin-authored content, browsed by every logged-in user via truth_of_bible.api.bible_places (never raw REST for a normal user — see that module's docstring). Referenced by TOB Bible Journey Stop to build guided journeys through multiple places.

fields.label: Category
fields.options:
City
Mountain
River
Sea
Region
Other

fields.label: Region
fields.description: e.g. "Israel", "Jordan", "Asia Minor", "Greece", "Rome" — the app groups places by this on the Bible Places browse screen.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Only Published places are ever returned to the app.

fields.label: Primary Verse Reference
fields.description: e.g. "Genesis 22:2" — the main verse this place is associated with, shown on its card.

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Lower shows first within the place's region on the browse screen.

fields.label: Photo URL
fields.description: A direct image URL shown on the place's card and map popover. Seeded with a curated stock photo; replace with a real photo any time.

fields.label: Facts
fields.description: One fact per line — shown as a bulleted list on the place's detail view.
